question_text: Using data(The modulus of elasticity for 17-4PH stainless steel is 196 GPa ( $196 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{MPa}$ ). Furthermore, the yield strength for this annealed stainless steel is 760 MPa.), estimate the modulus of restlience (in MPa) of annealed 17-4PH stainless steel.The unit of the answer is MPa.
response:
$$U_r \approx 1.4735 \ \text{MPa}$$

This represents the maximum energy per unit volume that annealed 17-4PH stainless steel can absorb in the elastic range and still recover without permanent deformation.

$$\boxed{1.4735}$$
